sources.title: Slither.io・Free STL File for 3D printing・Cults
sources.snippet: A very popular game Slither.io made us want to 3d print it. Each segment is made out of different shapes in TinkerCAD. Separately printed segments allow different combinations. It can be made into a bracelet. The segments can be multiplied in slicer. A raft is recommended for printing multiple small objects. 3D material PLA is well suited for this type of print.
